shortDescription: The number of rigs drilling for natural gas in the United States fell by 2 this week to 130, data from oil services firm Baker Hughes showed on Friday.Horizontal rigs - the type most often used to extract oil or gas from shale - was unchanged at 535.Oil rigs rose by 2 to 449.
